outputs.explanation: This is a stacked bar/area chart showing the trend of median promoter-state frequencies across a continuum of log2 Pol II ChIP-seq bins (n=5912 promoters aggregated per bin). It functions like a line/trend plot across a continuous ordered x-axis rather than a simple comparison of a few discrete group means, and overlaying thousands of individual promoter values on a stacked composition chart would be uninterpretable. Treated as exempt similar to line plots.

The single-molecule stack itself displays every individual DNA molecule (each row = one molecule, 2952 molecules) with its methylation pattern, which is the raw individual data underlying the state-frequency percentages shown in the adjacent color-coded sidebar. Individual data points are therefore shown alongside the summarized state frequencies.
Same representation as panel A (mouse data, n=6122 promoters): a stacked bar/area trend chart across Pol II ChIP-seq bins, exempt for the same reasons as panel A.

Same representation as panel B (mouse Skp1 locus): the single-molecule stack shows every individual molecule (2871 molecules), providing the individual data points behind the summarized state-frequency percentages in the sidebar.

Panel E is a box plot showing distribution of PIC occupancy frequencies, which already conveys the underlying distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, and outlier points), so it is exempt from requiring additional individual data point overlay.

Panel F is a box plot showing distribution of Pol II occupancy frequencies, which already conveys the underlying distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, and outlier points), so it is exempt from requiring additional individual data point overlay.
